name: com.ambiguous-interactive.signalfish.adapters.pun2
displayName: Signal Fish Room Bootstrap for Photon PUN2
description: Exchanges a Photon PUN2 room name over a Signal Fish room: the room owns matchmaking and membership, the host creates the PUN room and publishes its name over the room's game-data lane (re-published on every join), and clients join the PUN room whose name arrives on that lane. Requires Photon PUN 2 (detected by the included editor define detector), com.ambiguous-interactive.signalfish, and com.ambiguous-interactive.signalfish.adapters.core.

samples.description: A host/client bootstrap that wires the room-name exchange to PUN2's connect and matchmaking calls and logs the exchange as the session comes up.
